items.title: Turing Institute names Adrian Belton as new Chair of its Board of Trustees
items.summary_en: The Alan Turing Institute's homepage lists the appointment of Adrian Belton as Chair of the Board of Trustees, dated 3 November 2026. This is a governance announcement, not a research result. The details of the announcement were not read directly.
